headline: Dangote Refinery Secures Fuel Supply Deal with Cameroon State Refiner
summary: Nigeria's Dangote Group signed an agreement with Cameroon's state-owned oil refining company, SONARA, to supply refined petroleum products to the Central African country.
why: Cross-border fuel supply agreements strengthen regional trade corridors and expand distribution footprints for major domestic refiners.

impacts.name: Dangote Group
impacts.why: Securing long-term export supply agreements expands regional market share for refining operations.
